instructions: Operational service knowledge for this repository. Call knowledge_evidence_for_files before reading service source, and knowledge_search before grep, whenever the symptom-to-service mapping is unclear. Call knowledge_status when results look stale or empty, and knowledge_drift before trusting knowledge about recently changed code. These tools return evidence with citations, never conclusions.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Search operational service knowledge (per-repo FTS5 index). Returns an evidence bundle: routing header, top 3-7 ranked items (service/section/claim/probe) with interpretable T/L/I/A/F signals, citations, verification + freshness, applicable read-only probes, and links to the full skills. Read-only; returns evidence, never conclusions.

query.description: Free-text query (alert name, metric, concept, path).

service_id.description: Restrict/boost to a specific service id.

tools.name: knowledge_get
tools.description: Fetch a single knowledge item by id (full text + citations + link to its skill) OR a full SKILL.md by path. Read-only. Pass exactly one of item_id / skill_path.

skill_path.description: Repo-relative SKILL.md path for the full skill.

tools.name: knowledge_evidence_for_files
tools.description: Produce a §3.2 evidence bundle for a list of file paths. Routes by service territory ownership and returns routing header, top items, citations, verification + freshness, applicable read-only probes and full-skill links. Read-only.

paths.description: File paths to build evidence for.

tools.name: knowledge_status
tools.description: Report whether this repo's operational service knowledge is installed, indexed and current: consumer root, installed machinery version, umbrella packs with their service counts, the FTS5 index cache, git HEAD, and each service's last_sync_ref against HEAD. Use it to decide whether knowledge_search results can be trusted in this checkout. Read-only; never writes and never rebuilds.

tools.name: knowledge_drift
tools.description: Report which services' operational knowledge has drifted from the code: the pending drift marker (reason, services, commit range, timestamp), each service's recorded last_sync_ref against git HEAD, and the services whose knowledge is stale. Call this before trusting knowledge_search on a recently changed territory, and to decide whether to reconcile. Read-only: it never writes the marker and never rebuilds the index.
